seedOnly.refusal: {field} is OPC UA only: no other engine's provider reads it, so this connection would be listed as carrying it and would not. Remove {field} from this connection.

hints.text: The endpoint exactly as you type it. This is the only address dialled: a server may advertise another, and OPC PLC advertises its own container name, which resolves nowhere.
A server username, if the server checks one; empty for an anonymous session.

The password for that username. On a server whose UserName token declares its own policy the password is encrypted even in None mode; where it declares none, a password to a host that is not this machine is refused unless an SSH tunnel carries it.

None, Sign or SignAndEncrypt. None encrypts nothing and authenticates nobody, so a certificate cannot be pinned there and this connection refuses the pair rather than checking a thumbprint it read over a channel nobody authenticated. There is no fallback: a mode the server does not offer is refused rather than quietly weakened. A secured mode also needs TRUST both ways on the first connect: the server's certificate has to be moved into trusted/certs under the PKI directory, and the server has to accept this client's - until then a secured connect is refused, and the refusal names the directory.
The SHA-256 thumbprint this server's certificate must present, as 64 hexadecimal characters; colons and spaces are ignored. Without it any certificate the trust list accepts is accepted.
